notes.title: NEW PATCH - Double Memory v1.0104
notes.content:
On 09/24/2017 - Double Memory v1.0104 Patch was implemented.

The Double Memory Team has added a new button in the Options area.

If you click on the "STAR ANIMATIONS" toggle button, you can disable the Star Animation for correct answers.

NOTE: If you complete beat a stage the Star Animation will still play during a stage victory animation. 

ALSO!!!

We added screenshot support. So know users should be able to upload screenshots.

-Double Memory Team

notes.title: Double Memory v1.0101 Patch Notes - Fixed Final Achievement
notes.content:
Greetings Double Memory Players:

Big thanks to "JeLomun" for pointing out that the Achievement for beating the final stage was not properly initializing.

We have patched this issue and tested the achievement with version 1.0101 of Double Memory.


Players will need to beat the final stage again in order to properly activate the achievement known as "Spinning with Victory".

Thank you again JeLomun for being the first to let us know about this. 

-Double Memory Team
